conditions: reference_building_id must be one of the three Hazard reference profiles r1 buildings
ground_snow_load_kpa is the event ground snow load in kPa at the building, = 0.00980665 x snow water equivalent in mm
records are valid from 0 to 20 kPa; above 20 withholds; a negative load is rejected

office and warehouse need design_ground_snow_load_kpa (the building's design ground snow load; ASCE 7-22 Risk Category II layer by default) and the screening acknowledgement; the record of the band whose lower edge is the largest edge at or below the input is used
office and warehouse: ground_to_roof_case nsls2020_central (default) or kl047_severe; report both
house: house_fragility_variant printed_table4_r1 (default, central) or rebuild_65psf_r1 (lower sensitivity)
the damage ratio is a share of the whole structure's replacement cost new (sources state building value)
contents and interior water beyond the state definitions are withheld, never zero
scenario dollars stay withheld until the consumer qualifies the building value
SJ must confirm the per-cell design snow-load layer before office/warehouse records can run on the grid

prerequisites: Hazard event ground-snow-load and design-load layers

checks_required: record routing by building, edition, conversion case and design band
DR multiplied by the whole structure RCN, once
all perils on one building in one event at most 100 % of structure value
cap_binding.action_if_fail: withhold the affected DR; do not substitute another record or clamp

required_before_canonical_use: SJ confirms the per-cell design snow-load layer (ASCE 7-22 RC II) and the SWE product
ASCE 7-22 Chapter 7 and Strobel & Liel 2013 read, or their absence accepted
reviewer traces the per-curve methodology files
